name: agent.codex
doc: Run a supervised interactive Codex session on a spec in a working directory. Submit declared step outputs before the session ends; pass session to resume in the same directory. model is a JSON object, by default {"type":"normal","model":"sol","effort":"high"}: {"type":"normal","model":M,"effort":E?}, a model `codex debug models` lists (sol and astra name gpt-6.1-sol and gpt-6-astra) at an effort it supports. The result's model names what ran (docs("plans"), Choosing a model).
